label: AI SaaS landing page
prompt: 🔹 Context Create a high-converting, responsive landing page for an AI Writing Assistant using the existing SaaSAble React + Material UI Kit. The page needs to pitch the core features, showcase how the AI works, display pricing tiers, and build trust with social proof.🔹Requirements- Reuse existing SaaSAble blocks only.- Full responsiveness across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.- Material 3 design alignment using standard SaaSAble layout wrappers.- Smooth interactive components (such as pricing toggles) and micro-interactions.🔹 Suggested Block Usage- Navbar: Navbar1- Main Showcase: Hero12 (Split layout displaying typography copy on the left and an interactive text-editor mockup preview on the right)- Value Proposition: Feature1 (3-column multi-card grid with inline icon badges highlighting key product benefits)- Operational Sequence: Process3 (Horizontal linear numbered sequence walking through the user workflow)- Plan Comparison: Pricing2 (Multi-tier pricing grid equipped with a Monthly/Annual billing switch)- Social Proof: Testimonial4 (Multi-column masonry layout featuring client profiles and star ratings)- Bottom Conversion: CTA1- Footer: Footer1🎯 Expected Output Build a polished, conversion-optimized AI SaaS landing page entirely from existing SaaSAble blocks while maintaining a cohesive user experience.

label: Agency / portfolio site
prompt: 🔹 Context Create a modern, visually striking landing page for a Design Agency using the existing SaaSAble React + Material UI Kit. The page should emphasize bold layout architecture, showcase past projects, list creative disciplines, and drive inquiries. 🔹 Requirements - Reuse existing SaaSAble blocks only. - Fluid responsiveness optimized for high-resolution visual displays. - Consistent typography and dark-mode styling tokens compatible with the UI Kit. - Elegant hover interactions and smooth gallery transitions. 🔹 Suggested Block Usage - Navbar: Navbar2 - Creative Introduction: Hero7 (Typography-centric centered block with crisp taglines and action buttons) - Services Capabilities: Feature5 (Asymmetric block layout breaking down core design and engineering offerings) - Project Showcase: Gallery2 (Rich media grid component presenting case studies with dark-mode image overlays) - Contact Conversion: Contact3 (Split layout with project inquiry headings on the left and a minimalist contact form on the right) - Footer: Footer2 🎯 Expected Output Build a bold, high-impact design agency portfolio site entirely from existing SaaSAble blocks while maintaining a cohesive user experience.

label: Analytics Product page
prompt: 🔹 Context Create a high-impact Analytics Product Landing page with a heavy emphasis on live dashboards, pricing models, and ROI calculator elements using the existing SaaSAble React + Material UI Kit. 🔹 Requirements - Reuse existing SaaSAble blocks only. - Responsive across all viewports with specialized container padding for dense layout blocks. - Clean integration of interactive elements like toggle bars and data presentation cards. - Polished Material 3 typography alignments for complex metrics or price labels. 🔹 Suggested Block Usage - Navbar: Navbar1 - Value Introduction: Hero14 (Bold typography layout featuring a full dashboard data grid mockup directly below) - Functional Value: Feature8 (A grid layout prioritizing interactive data points and performance metrics) - Value Validation: Testimonial2 (Single high-profile customer pull-quote with massive text sizing) - Commercial Tiering: Pricing3 (An advanced horizontal pricing table for explicit feature-by-feature plan comparisons) - Retention Banner: CTA4 (Urgent, minimal layout focused entirely on driving immediate sign-ups) - Footer: Footer2 🎯 Expected Output Build an elegant, metrics-driven Analytics Landing and Pricing hub entirely from existing SaaSAble blocks while maintaining a cohesive user experience.
